# MedicoAI Learn

> AI-powered study companion for MBBS and BDS students — daily quizzes, flashcards, clinical case studies, OSCE practice, lecture recorder, and AI doubt solver tailored to your year and subjects.

MedicoAI Learn helps medical and dental students master their curriculum with adaptive practice, spaced-repetition flashcards, AI-generated summaries, mock exams, and progress analytics. First-time users pick MBBS or BDS, their year of study, and their subjects so every feature is course-aware.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Dashboard with daily streak, progress, and quick actions.
- [Daily Quiz](/quiz): Subject-wise multiple choice quizzes for your course.
- [Daily Challenge](/challenge): One curated challenge per day.
- [Flashcards](/flashcards): Spaced-repetition flashcards across your subjects.
- [Clinical Cases](/cases): Interactive clinical case scenarios.
- [OSCE Practice](/osce): Objective Structured Clinical Examination drills.
- [Doubt Solver](/doubt): Ask an AI tutor questions, including image-based.
- [Notes Summarizer](/summarizer): Turn long notes into concise summaries and cheat sheets.
- [Lecture Recorder](/recorder): Record lectures and convert audio to study notes.
- [Practice Mode](/practice): Convert summaries into spaced-repetition flashcards and quizzes.
- [Recap](/recap): Review previous topics and weak areas.
- [Notes](/notes): Personal notes library.
- [Study Plan](/study-plan): Personalized weekly study schedule.
- [Formula Sheet](/formula-sheet): Quick-reference clinical formulas.
- [Mock Exam](/mock-exam): Full-length mock exams.
- [Viva](/viva): Voice-based viva practice.
- [Previous Year Questions](/pyq): Past exam questions by subject.
- [Case Study](/case-study): Deeper case-based learning.
- [Diagram Quiz](/diagram-quiz): Identify anatomy and clinical diagrams.
- [Diagram Explain](/diagram-explain): AI-explained medical diagrams.
- [Drill](/drill): Rapid-fire question drills.
- [Mistakes](/mistakes): Review questions you got wrong.
- [Pomodoro Timer](/timer): Focus timer with session log.
- [Bookmarks](/bookmarks): Saved questions and notes.
- [Goals](/goals): Track study goals.
- [Test Marks](/marks): Log and analyze test marks.
- [Analytics](/analytics): Study analytics and trends.
- [Suggestions](/suggestions): Personalized study tips.

## Optional

- [Settings](/settings): Switch course, year, subjects, and app preferences.
